newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN BONDS AT DAY'S BEST LEVELS, RAND FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN BONDS AT DAY'S BEST LEVELS, RAND FIRMER.

text.p: 1413 GMT - Late bonds at day's best levels as local and offshore appetite continues unabated, traders say. More downside potential on yields seen next week.
Rand also moving slightly stronger after steady day marked by small importer/exporter flows.
* Benchmark R150 stock last at 14.915 pct from 14.975 percent in after-hours trade on Thursday. Option book trading ahead of May 2 close-out also adding to buying interest.
* Market awaiting flood of economic indicators next week with inflation, money supply and trade numbers all due out.

* Rand last at 4.4505/4535 vs range-bound U.S. dlr and from 4.4535/4565 overnight. Seen continuing in established 4.44 to 4.47 range early next week and no major moves expected. Market driven purely by demand/supply activity.
